name: migrate-pi
title: Migrate to pi (from Claude Code, untested)
use: Untested template: port this repo's Claude Code setup to pi; Claude files stay the source, pi gets links or copies.
rules:
Run from Claude Code. Sidereus only lights the stages; this session does the work with its own permissions.
Claude files stay the source of truth. pi gets symlinks or copies generated by a script in the repo. ⚠Never hand-edit two copies of one file.
Context: pi loads one context file per directory, the first of AGENTS.override.md, AGENTS.md, AGENTS.MD, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.MD. With both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, pi skips CLAUDE.md.
Skills: move .claude/skills/* to .agents/skills/ (Agent Skills dir, read by pi) and symlink .claude/skills to it; project .agents/skills loads only after project trust.
Agents: need the subagent example extension in ~/.pi/agent/extensions/subagent/ (index.ts + agents.ts). Project agents go in .pi/agents/*.md, same frontmatter (name, description, tools, model). Tools lowercase: Read>read, Edit>edit, Write>write, Bash>bash, Grep>grep, Glob>find; drop Web* and Agent. model: inherit = omit the key. Call with agentScope "both".
Commands: pi prompt templates in .pi/prompts/*.md (direct children only; $ARGUMENTS and $1 work). Project ones load only after project trust.
MCP: copy each mcpServers entry into ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json (.pi/mcp.json for project-only servers, trust needed).
Hooks: pi extension handlers (session_start, tool_call, tool_execution_end, agent_settled, ...). Sidereus' own hooks come from Settings › «Diagnostics» › «Connect»; port only project-specific hooks.
Parallel work: pi codemode runs tool calls in parallel in one turn; nested calls pass the same tool_call handlers.
Pipelines: not mapped. The pi subagent tool has no description field, so [pl:] stage tags cannot ride on it.
Mailbox id: to keep this folder's Claude id in pi, add "pi:<cwd>": "<id>" to the mailbox identity.json; otherwise pi uses <folder>-pi.
after: In pi: run /reload (or restart pi) after any extension change; a session started before the install does not load it.
Rerun the generator script after every edit of a Claude agent or command; never edit the generated copy.

stages.title: Inventory
stages.task: Read-only. Count per type under .claude/ and the repo root: context files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md), skills (.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md), agents (.claude/agents/*.md), commands (.claude/commands/**/*.md), .mcp.json servers, hook entries in .claude/settings*.json, pipelines (.claude/pipelines/*.json). Also note existing .agents/, .pi/ and symlinks. Output a table: item, count, paths. Change nothing.

stages.title: Map
stages.task: Read-only. For each Inventory row give the pi target path and method: as-is | symlink | convert | not mapped, with a one-line reason from the rules. Flag: both AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md present (pi reads only AGENTS.md), agents using tools with no pi equivalent, commands in subfolders or with Claude-only frontmatter, hooks that Sidereus «Connect» already covers. Output a table: item, pi target, method, reason.

stages.title: Convert
stages.task: Apply the Map table. Symlinks for shared dirs (.claude/skills -> .agents/skills). Converted copies come from one script in the repo (e.g. scripts/gen-pi-agents.mjs: read .claude/agents/*.md, rewrite tool names and model, write .pi/agents/*.md); add the generated paths to .gitignore. MCP entries go to ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json, merged, existing entries kept. Port only project-specific hooks to a .pi/extensions/ handler. ⚠No hand-edited duplicate of any Claude file. Report changed files.

stages.title: Verify
stages.task: Run what works outside a pi session: `pi mcp list` (every copied server listed, no config error), `pi --list-models <model>` for each generated agent model (resolves to the intended model), the generator script twice (second run changes nothing), and the repo's real gate (e.g. git pre-commit). List for the person the in-pi checks: /reload after extension install, one subagent call with agentScope both, skills and prompts listed. FAIL on any mismatch.

stages.title: Report
stages.task: Read-only. One table: item, method, result. Then every item left not mapped (hooks not ported, pipeline stage tags, tools dropped from agents), one line each with the reason, and the in-pi checks the person still has to run.
